visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short hair wearing a cream-colored headband with small ears sits on the floor of a brightly lit living room. She is dressed in dark blue silk pajamas and holds a black smartphone. In the background, a boy is lying on a gray sectional sofa. (2) The woman leans her face directly into the grill of a beige pedestal fan, singing with an expressive and joyful face. The scene cuts to different close-up angles of her mouth and face near the fan. (3) The woman detaches the front grill of the fan and holds it up to the camera, gesturing towards the blades inside to demonstrate the cleaning feature. Animated pink heart graphics appear briefly around her. (4) The scene shifts to a bedroom where a boy in a black t-shirt and track pants is dribbling a basketball on a light wooden floor. A similar beige fan stands in the corner near a bed with a blue Care Bear plush. (5) Back in the living room, the woman crouches next to the fan, which is now oscillating vertically. She points to the fan's head as it moves up and down. (6) A close-up shot focuses on the base of the fan, showing a control panel with various touch icons and blue LED indicators. (7) The woman stands or kneels as she adjusts the height of the fan, pulling the neck upwards to show its extension. (8) The woman smiles widely and gives a double thumbs-up to the camera as pink heart overlays and a large yellow 'thumbs up' graphic appear.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female voice speaks with moderate speed, immediately followed by a short electronic 'ding' chime. A synthesized, cute AI female voice responds with clear articulation. (2) Fast-tempo pop music with a strong electronic beat begins. The primary female voice sings with high energy and dramatic pitch shifts. The background noise of the fan blades creates a subtle, airy acoustic texture beneath the vocals. (3) The music lowers in volume, acting as a background bed. The female voice speaks in a narrative, persuasive tone, detailing features. A sharp 'click' sound is heard as a mechanical component is handled. (4) A series of hollow percussive thuds occur as a basketball hits the floor. A child's higher-pitched voice is heard interacting with the same AI voice, accompanied by another notification chime. (5) A consistent mechanical whirring sound of a small motor is heard as the fan oscillates. The main female voice laughs briefly, followed by more rapid speech describing technical details. The track ends with a bright, synthesized sparkle sound effect.
